Package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property

package dev.shvquu.betternpcs.api.npc.property
The immutable value objects an NPC is configured with — position, skin, equipment, appearance, visibility, look behaviour and floating text.

All of them are immutable and safe to share between threads and between NPCs. Types with more than a couple of fields are built through a nested Builder and offer toBuilder() for deriving a modified copy.
